summary.tldr: Creates a Commissioner for Modern Treaty Implementation to review and audit government work on modern treaties, and sets up an office to support that role.
what_it_does: Creates a Commissioner for Modern Treaty Implementation.
Gives the commissioner power to conduct reviews and performance audits of government institutions related to implementing modern treaties.
Creates an Office of the Commissioner for Modern Treaty Implementation to support the commissioner’s mandate, powers, duties and functions.
Makes consequential amendments to other Acts.
